spec.title: AI-Native Lean card E — Targeted proof loop

status.comment: BETA projection; narrower checker scope and WISH gaps are explicit.

p.INTENT: Return a bounded selected-subject checker signal before making a proof claim.

p.APPLICABILITY: A small model, theorem, source dependency or carrier binding changes.

p.MOTIVATION: A reader should consume an explicit, checkable operation rather than infer a claim from prose or a stale artifact.

p.STRUCTURE: Named subject, checker request, diagnostics and fresh witness verification.

p.SCOPE: The targeted runner is the initial loop. Whole-project floor/conform/health and automatic card activation are WISH.

p.CONSEQUENCES: Makes the declared boundary reviewable; requires explicit inputs, assumptions and checker time. No broader proof grade follows.

p.ALTERNATIVES: A direct Lean command can diagnose syntax; the family runner binds the subject and witness contract.

p.RISKS: Long proof search can exceed a configured budget; report checker failure/timeout without a success witness. Sunset: revise or retire this card when an accepted checker/representation makes its routine obsolete.

p.EVIDENCE: No package-specific empirical result is claimed. [E-hyp]. This BETA card is grounded in the machine contract spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#root; required runner acceptance cases are at spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#NEGATIVE-CASES. WISH fields identify absent machinery.

band-three.title: Band 3 — Operation
band-three.fence: trigger: WHEN A small model, theorem, source dependency or carrier binding changes. mode: gate routine: 1. Select the exact subject. 2. Inspect the model and assumptions. 3. Make the bounded edit. 4. Run scan and the targeted check. 5. Read the returned diagnostics. 6. Freshly verify a saved witness before reuse. checker: lean-ai-native --path . check --carrier lean-proof.toml --subject <fully-qualified-subject> raid_role: layer=proof; order=after:independent-contract; batch=theorem budget: active_rules=1; first_signal=one targeted operation within its configured bound
